requirements.text: Every delegated Claude subagent — all .claude/agents/*.md definitions, dispatched producers, Claude-based review agents, and the supervisor loop worker — runs model claude-opus-4-8 at xhigh effort as the standing selection.
requirements.required_harness: git diff of .claude/agents/*.md at the execution commit showing model: claude-opus-4-8 and effort: xhigh on every subagent definition; runtime spot-check of a dispatched agent's effective model identity before loop relaunch

requirements.text: Prohibition: do not use Opus 5, Fable 5, Sonnet 5, or any other model or effort for delegated subagents; do not silently substitute; do not label high, max, or an ignored field as xhigh. Verify the runtime can actually express xhigh, or report one precise blocker.
requirements.required_harness: Effort-key acceptance verified against installed runtime behavior (existing effort: high key already honored in the same files; xhigh precedent D-004 reviewer fallback).
requirements.required_evidence: execution commit; any blocker record if xhigh is inexpressible

requirements.text: Owner decision: the main interactive agent (orchestrator session) stays on claude-fable-5. This directive changes subagent scope only; the settings model key for the main session is not changed on this instruction.
requirements.required_harness: settings model selection for the main session remains claude-fable-5 at the execution commit
requirements.required_evidence: .claude/settings.json (or equivalent settings surface) unchanged for the main-session model key

requirements.text: Record the supersession: the D-055 fable-for-delegated-work selection, D-058-R004 fable-via-extra-usage loop pin, and the D-060 revert-to-Fable-on-availability duty are superseded FOR THE SUBAGENT/WORKER SCOPE ONLY by this standing Opus 4.8 xhigh preference. History is preserved; no historical record is rewritten; the directives remain active for their other content.
requirements.required_harness: This requirement row plus the manifest audit_log entry constitute the supersession record; D-055/D-058/D-060 files untouched.

requirements.text: Property source links must lead first to a human-readable official page showing the selected lot (the ZoLa lot page, built from a constant prefix plus the validated borough/block/lot), wherever the UI currently presents the raw PLUTO JSON resource URL as the primary current-record link. The raw official JSON record and the dataset landing page remain available as clearly secondary links; the M5-T030 identity/conflict guards and provenance rules are preserved unchanged.
requirements.required_harness: Bound ledger task with component tests (valid BBL builds the ZoLa lot URL; invalid/absent identity renders honest absence; JSON record still reachable) plus a live spot-check on a known BBL.
requirements.required_evidence: ledger task packet and gate reports for the link change (task id appended to this row's applicability at contract time)

requirements.text: Add a one-line lean-communication rule to CLAUDE.md: plain facts, short answers, no jargon, no over-explaining, answer only the question asked. The rule governs owner-facing replies, subagent prompts and returns, and messages sent to the Codex reviewer in the loop.
requirements.required_harness: CLAUDE.md diff at the execution commit

requirements.text: Batched verification: producers run only the focused tests for their edited scope while building; the full unit/component suite and browser journeys run once per integration seam on the frozen candidate, not once per task. This applies the owner's 'big portion of the job, then run through all the tests all at once' instruction within permanent principle 17's progressive-verification bounds; no test is weakened or deleted to achieve speed.
requirements.required_harness: Task packets from this date forward name focused self-check commands; one full regression recorded at each integration seam.
requirements.required_evidence: task packets and seam checkpoint records

requirements.text: Sequencing: relaunch the build loop only after the owner performs the model_selection.toml edit (R009). The first relaunch packet is the address-search reliability defect (handoff Section 6) together with the lot-link change (R005), contracted under the normal gated process.
requirements.required_harness: Loop launch record shows the worker on claude-opus-4-8 and the first packet's ledger id.
requirements.required_evidence: loop launch log; ledger task packet

requirements.text: Owner action (owner-only by controller S3.2 rule 6): edit C:\SupervisorController\model_selection.toml changing the model value claude-fable-5 to claude-opus-4-8. This actuates the B-024 recovery; the agent must not perform or bypass this edit.
requirements.required_harness: Controller doctor / model_selection digest read after the owner edit confirms model claude-opus-4-8.
requirements.required_evidence: controller doctor output recorded at relaunch; B-024 update

requirements.text: After relaunch the orchestrator monitors quietly: the loop does the building; the orchestrator reports only major breaks (errors, stalls, kills, run end) per the established quiet-monitor posture.
requirements.required_harness: Session behavior; loop watcher armed with the quiet filter.
requirements.required_evidence: monitoring posture noted in the relaunch record

requirements.text: Return item: after execution give the owner one concise reconciliation — branch/deploy state recognized, effective subagent model/effort, remaining real blockers, and the first bounded task started — in the lean style of R006.
requirements.required_evidence: session transcript; handoff/knowledge update at the seam
